content: {"summary":"To safely reduce a Kafka topic's retention you must verify the broker and volume, identify the largest topics, review the current retention settings, ensure consumers are not lagging behind, confirm the topic's cleanup policy, check segment configuration, understand retention.bytes per partition, and avoid shortening audit‑retained topics like ledger.entries.","likely_cause":"N/A – the question asks for preventive checks, not a specific incident cause.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Confirm which broker and which volume before changing retention","evidence_ids":["RB-009#1"],"quote":"Confirm which broker and which volume. On each broker, run `df -h /data/kafka`"},{"text":"Identify the biggest topics consuming disk space","evidence_ids":["RB-009#1"],"quote":"Find the biggest topics. Over the last year, `ledger.entries` and `notifications.outbound` have been the top two every time"},{"text":"Check the topic's current retention configuration","evidence_ids":["RB-009#1"],"quote":"Check the topic's current retention."},{"text":"Verify consumer lag so no unread messages are dropped","evidence_ids":["RB-009#2"],"quote":"Check consumers before you shorten anything. Note the largest `LAG`."},{"text":"Ensure the topic is not compacted, because compacted topics ignore retention.ms","evidence_ids":["RB-009#5"],"quote":"`cleanup.policy=compact`, `retention.ms` doesn't bound size the same way."},{"text":"Confirm segment settings because active segments are never deleted","evidence_ids":["RB-009#5"],"quote":"Retention only removes closed segments. The active segment of each partition is never deleted."},{"text":"Remember retention.bytes applies per partition, not per topic","evidence_ids":["RB-009#5"],"quote":"`retention.bytes` is per partition, not per topic."},{"text":"Do not shorten ledger.entries retention without approval (14‑day audit retention)","evidence_ids":["RB-009#5"],"quote":"`ledger.entries` has a 14-day retention for audit reasons."}],"next_checks":["Review the actual retention.ms values for the target topic(s)","Gather current consumer group lag metrics for those topics","Confirm the cleanup.policy value in the topic description","Check segment.ms and segment.bytes settings for active segment behavior","Calculate expected disk usage using retention.bytes per partition","Obtain finance‑ops sign‑off before modifying ledger.entries retention"]}
